items.title: A Brother’s Fountain
items.description: After the Banff Centre Mountain Film Festival's keynote event Sarah Hueniken, Ines Papert – and Films, on November 6 at 7:30 p.m., keep the party going in CLVB ’33 with a special guest performance from Colorado's favourite "campfire folk" group A Brother’s Fountain.

items.title: Banff Winterstart Night Race
items.description: Join a moving river of light for five unforgettable miles through Banff. Feel the energy of the start, settle into your stride beneath the Rockies, and carry that momentum all the way to a warm, welcoming finish at the Rundlestone Lodge.

items.title: Visual Arts Open Lecture Series: Deanna Bowen
items.description: Join us for an afternoon Visual Arts lecture with Deanna Bowen, a Montreal-based interdisciplinary artist whose practice includes films, video installations, performances, drawing, sculpture and photography.

items.title: Visual Arts Open Lecture Series: Tania Willard
items.description: Join us for an afternoon Visual Arts lecture with Tania Willard, a mixed Secwépemc and settler artist whose research intersects with land-based art practices.

items.title: Visual Arts Open Lecture Series: Tarah Hogue
items.description: Join Banff Centre for an afternoon Visual Arts lecture with writer and curator Tarah Hogue, based in Treaty 6 and 7 territories and the Métis homeland.

items.title: Mountain Writers Intensive Reading
items.description: Celebrate the power of words shaped by mountains at the Mountain Writers Intensive Reading, a free public event in Banff Centre's intimate CLVB '33. items.title: Banff residents can now recycle more
items.description: Plastic bags, styrofoam, candy wrappers, coffee cups among materials that can now be diverted from landfill!

items.title: New drop-in recreation sessions offer more ways to use your Pauw Pass
items.description: From badminton to roller disco, and soccer to pickleball, there is something for everyone in the Town of Banff’s updated drop-in recreation schedule.

items.title: Banff Winterstart Night Run — November 7
items.description: On Saturday, November 7, lace up. Switch on your headlamp. Run beneath the Rockies.

items.title: WinterStart Race Traffic Info and Road Closures — Nov. 7
items.description: On Saturday, November 7, 2026, Banff hosts the Winterstart Night Run. Traffic will experience detours from 6 p.m. – 9:30 p.m.

items.title: Final week to join Banff decision-makers
items.description: The Town is seeking Banff residents for roles on boards, commissions and committees that make decisions about the future of the community on key topics such as affordable housing, commercial/residential development, policing, public art, community grants
